implementation.physical_audio: Injected AudioRecorder copies a pinned public corpus WAV into the production writer; CPAL/microphone and AudioHub physical queues are not exercised
implementation.cancellations: Every capture cycle uses the production coordinator and scheduler. By default 990 requests are cancelled before transport and 10 after the complete Transcribe frame is acknowledged by the actual stdin writer, with CPU activity observed. Native kernel entry is not instrumented.
implementation.worker_faults: Kill only the currently owned live loaded-idle CPU helper, detect transport failure, confirm process reap and stdio cleanup, reopen and reload through production WorkerSession. This does not test automatic SttEngine recovery routing.
implementation.cleanup: Dedicated test process enters its own noninheritable kill-on-close Windows Job before any worker starts; a kernel handle watches the exact controlling Node runner, and an independent native deadline stops the driver if the runner disappears or stalls.
implementation.resource_measurements: Read-only Win32 handles, threads, private bytes and cumulative CPU time for the native driver and owned helper; thread enumeration fails closed on API errors or zero threads for a live process.
implementation.resource_gates: Compare parent warm loaded baseline with final loaded state, and settled warm no-worker baseline with final shutdown while the same Pipeline/job/watchdog remain alive. Handles and threads cannot increase; private bytes allowance is max(5%, 10 MiB). Cold pre-worker startup differences are descriptive and excluded from leak gates.
implementation.latency_measurements: Capture start, capture stop, uncontended scheduler acquire, cancellation-to-request-return and fault reload p50/p95/p99; first-session load and first/warm inference are separate. No cold OS-cache claim.
